tests.name: Prime Health Assessment Profile
tests.tagline: Essential full body preventive assessment covering all vital organs
tests.description: Complete general wellness evaluation monitoring bone health, renal function, liver enzymes, heart lipid ratios, and glycemic control.
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours overnight fasting required. Water intake allowed. Morning sample recommended.

tests.name: Tru Wellness Profile (Women) - 1
tests.tagline: Comprehensive women's vitality screen including hormones, iron & bone profile
tests.description: Laboratory panel for women covering the listed metabolic, blood count, calcium and thyroid measurements. Blood calcium testing does not measure bone density. Discuss the appropriate tests with your clinician.
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours fasting required. Recommended in morning hours.

tests.name: Tru Wellness Profile (Men) - 2
tests.tagline: Preventive vitality assessment tailored for adult and senior men
tests.description: Multi-system evaluation covering prostate health markers, cardiac lipid ratios, liver detoxification, kidney health, and uric acid.
testsIncluded: Renal Function Test (Creatinine, Urea, Uric Acid)
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours overnight fasting. Avoid heavy exercise 24 hours prior.

tests.name: Tru Pre Operative Profile
tests.tagline: Essential pre-surgical surgical fitness & coagulation clearance panel
tests.description: A listed preoperative laboratory panel. The surgical and anaesthetic team decides which tests are appropriate for the planned procedure and the patient’s health; this panel is not required for every surgery.
tests.preparation: 4-6 hours fasting preferred. Bring current medication prescription.

tests.name: Avinya Whole Body Oncology & Metabolic Assessment
tests.tagline: 72 Essential Parameters combining full body vitals and tumor screening
tests.description: Our flagship preventive healthcare panel combining comprehensive organ profiling with key tumor markers and vitamin levels.
testsIncluded: Renal & Kidney Profile with eGFR (8 Parameters)
Full Lipid & Cardiac Risk Profile (9 Parameters)
tests.preparation: 12 hours overnight fasting mandatory. Free water permitted.

tests.name: Comprehensive Cancer Biomarker Panel
tests.tagline: Clinician-directed testing with medical interpretation
tests.description: Blood panel for clinician-directed evaluation and monitoring. Tumor markers may be raised in noncancerous conditions and may be normal when cancer is present. This panel is not a reliable general population cancer screen and does not diagnose or exclude cancer.
testsIncluded: PSA Total & Free Ratio - Prostate Health
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours fasting. Morning draw recommended.

tests.name: Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) - Total & Free Ratio
tests.tagline: Clinician-directed testing with medical interpretation
tests.description: Measures prostate-specific antigen. PSA may rise with benign conditions as well as prostate cancer. Discuss the possible benefits and harms of screening with a clinician; PSA alone does not diagnose cancer. Further assessment may be needed.
tests.preparation: Avoid sexual activity or bicycle riding for 48 hours before testing.

tests.name: CA 125 (Ovarian Cancer Biomarker)
tests.tagline: Clinician-directed testing with medical interpretation
tests.description: Measures CA-125 for use in appropriate clinical evaluation or monitoring. Noncancerous conditions can raise CA-125, and some cancers do not raise it. It is not a reliable standalone ovarian cancer screen for people without symptoms.
tests.preparation: No special dietary restrictions. Best avoided during active menstruation.

tests.name: CA 19.9 (Pancreatic & Gastrointestinal Marker)
tests.tagline: Clinician-directed testing with medical interpretation
tests.description: Measures CA 19-9 to support clinician-directed evaluation or monitoring. Benign conditions can raise it and some cancers do not. It is not a reliable general population screening test or a standalone cancer diagnosis.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting recommended (8 hours).

tests.name: CA 15.3 (Breast Cancer Biomarker)
tests.tagline: Circulating serum antigen used in breast cancer monitoring and staging
tests.description: Specific mucin glycoprotein screen utilized for breast tumor management and monitoring therapeutic response.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Routine blood sample.

tests.name: Carcino Embryonic Antigen (CEA)
tests.tagline: General oncofetal antigen for colorectal, lung & gastrointestinal cancer
tests.description: Established tumor marker that circulates in elevated concentrations in colorectal carcinoma, medullary thyroid, and GI tumors.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting (8-10 hours) recommended.

tests.name: Alpha Feto Protein (AFP)
tests.tagline: Specific biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) & germ cell tumors
tests.description: Quantitative serum assay used for primary liver cancer screening in chronic hepatitis patients and testicular germ cell tumors.
tests.preparation: Fasting not strictly required; morning sample preferred.

tests.name: Lipid Profile (Complete Heart & Cholesterol Panel)
tests.tagline: Crucial cardiac risk screen assessing cholesterol and circulating blood lipids
tests.description: Evaluates good (HDL) and bad (LDL/VLDL) cholesterol and triglyceride levels to determine overall atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk.
tests.preparation: 12 hours overnight fasting mandatory. Avoid fatty foods or alcohol the evening before.

tests.name: Cardiac Risk Profile - 1
tests.tagline: Preventive cardiology panel assessing arterial inflammation & lipids
tests.description: Specialized cardiac profile evaluating plaque vulnerability, homocysteine vascular stress, and lipid subfractions.
tests.preparation: 12 hours fasting required. Drink plain water freely.

tests.name: Cardiac Risk Profile - 2 (Comprehensive)
tests.tagline: Our most exhaustive cardiovascular assessment with Lipoprotein (a)
tests.description: Complete cardiometabolic panel measuring hereditary Lipoprotein(a), myocardial stress enzymes, vascular inflammation, and lipid ratios.
tests.preparation: 12 hours strict fasting required.

tests.name: High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (hs-CRP)
tests.tagline: Ultra-sensitive biomarker of vascular inflammation and future cardiac risk
tests.description: Detects low-grade chronic arterial inflammation predictive of atherosclerotic plaque rupture and coronary events.
testsIncluded: AHA/CDC Cardiac Risk Stratification (Low, Average, High Risk)
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Avoid test during active acute bacterial infection or fever.

tests.name: D-DIMER (Thrombosis & Blood Clotting)
tests.tagline: Rapid test for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism risk
tests.description: Fibrin degradation product assay assessing the activation of the blood coagulation system and potential thrombotic events.
tests.preparation: No fasting required.

tests.name: NT-Pro BNP (Heart Failure Biomarker)
tests.tagline: Definitive biomarker for congestive heart failure and ventricular strain
tests.description: High-precision cardiac neurohormone assay for evaluating dyspnea, heart failure staging, and ventricular volume overload.
tests.preparation: No fasting required.

tests.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin - 3 Month Sugar Average)
tests.tagline: Gold-standard check providing estimated average blood glucose over 90 days
tests.description: HPLC-certified HbA1c test unaffected by daily food fluctuations, critical for diagnosing prediabetes and monitoring diabetic control.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Can be done anytime of the day.

tests.name: Blood Glucose Fasting & Post Prandial (PP) Duo
tests.tagline: Classic 2-point glucose test to monitor fasting and meal glycemic response
tests.description: Measures baseline glucose after overnight fasting and metabolic sugar clearance exactly 2 hours after a standard meal.
testsIncluded: Post Prandial Blood Sugar (PPBS 2 Hours Post Meal)
tests.preparation: 1st sample: 8-10 hours fasting. 2nd sample: exactly 2 hours after breakfast or meal.

tests.name: Tru Diabetes Profile Basic
tests.tagline: Essential diabetes profile with HbA1c, kidney function & lipid health
tests.description: Combines 3-month sugar control with essential screening for diabetic kidney stress and cholesterol abnormalities.
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours overnight fasting mandatory.

tests.name: Tru Diabetic Profile Advance
tests.tagline: Full-scale diabetes evaluation with insulin resistance & kidney microalbumin
tests.description: Specialized panel assessing pancreatic beta-cell reserve, insulin resistance index, microvascular kidney damage, and lipid profiles.
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours fasting for 1st draw; 2nd draw 2 hours post meal.

tests.name: HOMA Index Insulin Resistance Test
tests.tagline: Measure insulin sensitivity and beta-cell pancreatic function
tests.description: Calculation using fasting glucose and insulin measurements to support a clinician’s assessment of insulin resistance. Interpretation depends on the clinical context.
testsIncluded: HOMA-IR (Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin Resistance)
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours overnight fasting strictly required.

tests.name: Thyroid Profile Total (TFT - T3, T4, TSH)
tests.tagline: Comprehensive 3-parameter thyroid function check for metabolism & fatigue
tests.description: Primary screening test to diagnose hypothyroidism (underactive) or hyperthyroidism (overactive) thyroid glands.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting preferred. Take regular thyroid medicine after the blood collection.

tests.name: Free TFT (Free T3, Free T4, TSH Ultrasensitive)
tests.tagline: Active unbound thyroid hormone evaluation unaffected by binding proteins
tests.description: Accurately evaluates active biologically available FT3 and FT4, particularly indicated during pregnancy or oral hormone use.
tests.preparation: Fasting preferred. Morning sample before daily medication.

tests.name: Thyroid Auto Antibodies (Anti-TG & Anti-TPO)
tests.tagline: Detect Hashimoto's thyroiditis and autoimmune thyroid disease
tests.description: Evaluates circulating autoantibodies attacking thyroid peroxidase and thyroglobulin, confirming autoimmune thyroid disorder.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Morning sample recommended.

tests.name: Testosterone Panel (Total & Free)
tests.tagline: Complete androgen balance for libido, muscle mass, energy and vitality
tests.description: Assesses total circulating and biologically active free testosterone levels in adult men and women.
tests.preparation: Early morning collection (between 7:00 AM - 10:00 AM) when testosterone peaks.

tests.name: PCOS Profile (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Panel)
tests.tagline: Essential hormonal and glycemic evaluation for irregular cycles & acne
tests.description: Specially structured diagnostic panel screening the core hormonal triggers of PCOS including LH/FSH surge, androgen excess, and insulin resistance.
tests.preparation: 8-10 hours fasting. Recommended on Day 2 to Day 5 of menstrual cycle.

tests.name: PCOD Profile (Comprehensive Ovary & Metabolic Evaluation)
tests.tagline: Detailed hormonal panel including Estradiol, DHEAS & Thyroid TSH
tests.description: Exhaustive evaluation covering ovarian and adrenal androgens, pituitary gonadotropins, thyroid status, and glucose regulation.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting (10 hours). Best done on Days 2-5 of menstrual period.

tests.name: Anti Mullerian Hormone (AMH - Ovarian Egg Reserve)
tests.tagline: Evaluate biological ovarian egg count, fertility potential and menopause status
tests.description: Single most reliable blood biomarker for evaluating a woman's ovarian egg reserve, planning IVF/fertility, and detecting early ovarian aging.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Can be done on any day of the menstrual cycle.

tests.name: FSH, LH & Prolactin Hormonal Triad
tests.tagline: Pituitary reproductive hormones check for menstrual regularity & ovulation
tests.description: Evaluates reproductive axis control to investigate irregular periods, unexplained infertility, galactorrhea, or menopausal transition.
tests.preparation: Fasting not strictly required; morning draw recommended.

tests.name: Double Marker - First Trimester (Maternal Screen)
tests.tagline: Early pregnancy prenatal screening for chromosomal aneuploidies (Down Syndrome)
tests.description: Performed between weeks 11 to 13.6 of pregnancy to assess risk factors for Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21) and Edwards Syndrome (Trisomy 18).
testsIncluded: Trisomy Risk Assessment Calculation with NT Scan correlation
tests.preparation: Requires recent USG NT scan report (done between 11 to 13.6 weeks).

tests.name: Triple Marker - Second Trimester (Maternal Screen)
tests.tagline: Second trimester prenatal screen for neural tube defects & Trisomy 21
tests.description: Performed between weeks 15 to 20 of pregnancy measuring maternal hormones and fetal proteins to check neural tube development.
tests.preparation: Provide latest obstetric ultrasound report indicating gestational age (15-20 weeks).

tests.name: Amenorrhoea Profile
tests.tagline: Diagnostic workup for absent or stopped menstrual cycles
tests.description: Thorough hormonal investigation evaluating potential ovarian, pituitary, and systemic reasons for amenorrhea or missed cycles.
tests.preparation: Morning blood draw recommended.

tests.name: LFT - Liver Function Test (Complete 11 Parameters)
tests.tagline: Complete hepatic enzyme, bilirubin and protein synthesis assessment
tests.description: Evaluates liver inflammation, jaundice, drug toxicity, and fatty liver disease through comprehensive transaminases and protein ratios.
tests.preparation: 8-10 hours fasting recommended. Avoid alcohol for 48 hours prior.

tests.name: Kidney Profile & Electrolytes (Renal Care)
tests.tagline: Essential renal filtration screen with serum sodium, potassium & chloride
tests.description: Evaluates kidney glomerular filtration, fluid balance, and urea waste excretion along with critical cellular electrolytes.
tests.preparation: Fasting 8-10 hours. Drink water freely to maintain hydration.

tests.name: Serum Creatinine & Blood Urea Duo
tests.tagline: Quick vital kidney clearance test and eGFR estimated filtration rate
tests.description: Rapid baseline test to monitor kidney function before IV contrast imaging or during ongoing hypertension or medication therapy.
tests.preparation: Fasting preferred. Avoid excessive meat consumption the night before.

tests.name: Microalbumin Creatinine Ratio - ACR Urine
tests.tagline: Early detection of diabetic nephropathy and microscopic renal protein leakage
tests.description: Sensitive urine assay detecting subclinical microalbuminuria years before standard dipstick tests can identify kidney disease.
tests.preparation: Early morning first-void urine sample is optimal. Avoid strenuous exercise.

tests.name: Urine Complete Routine & Microscopic (Urinalysis)
tests.tagline: Complete physical, chemical and microscopic urine examination
tests.description: Evaluates urinary tract infections, renal stones, diabetes spillover, and cellular casts via automated microscopy.
testsIncluded: Physical: Color, Transparency, Specific Gravity, pH
Chemical: Protein, Sugar, Ketones, Bilirubin, Urobilinogen, Blood, Nitrite
Microscopic: Pus Cells (WBC), RBC, Epithelial Cells, Casts, Crystals, Bacteria
tests.preparation: Clean-catch midstream urine sample collected in a sterile container provided by phlebotomist.

tests.name: CBC - Complete Hemogram Test (28 Parameters)
tests.tagline: Exhaustive automated blood count assessing anemia, immunity & platelets
tests.description: Analyzes red blood cells, white blood cell differentials, absolute counts, platelet reserves, and ESR for infection or inflammation.
testsIncluded: Total RBC Count & Packed Cell Volume (PCV)
Differential Count (Neutrophils, Lymphocytes, Monocytes, Eosinophils, Basophils)
Absolute Neutrophil, Lymphocyte, Monocyte & Eosinophil Counts
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Can be tested at any time of day.

tests.name: Iron Studies Profile (Iron, TIBC, Transferrin Saturation)
tests.tagline: Comprehensive assessment of circulating iron stores and binding capacity
tests.description: Differentiates iron deficiency anemia from chronic disease anemia and evaluates iron overload or hemochromatosis.
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours fasting. Morning draw mandatory as serum iron varies during the day.

tests.name: Anemia Profile Basic (Iron Deficiency Anemia)
tests.tagline: Exhaustive anemia evaluation combining CBC, Iron, TIBC & Ferritin
tests.description: Measures serum ferritin to support clinician-directed assessment of iron status. Interpret with symptoms and other laboratory findings.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting (10 hours). Avoid iron supplements for 24 hours prior.

tests.name: Vitamin Plus (Vitamin B12 & D3 Vital Duo)
tests.tagline: The most requested vitamin panel for bone pain, tingling and fatigue
tests.description: Evaluates Vitamin D3 for calcium absorption and bone strength, combined with Vitamin B12 for nerve myelination and energy.
tests.preparation: Fasting preferred (8-10 hours).

tests.name: 25 OH Vitamin D (Total D2 + D3)
tests.tagline: Blood measurement of 25-hydroxyvitamin D
tests.description: Measures blood 25-hydroxyvitamin D. This is not a bone density measurement. Ask your clinician how the result should be interpreted.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Blood sample.

tests.name: Vitamin B12 (Active Cobalamin)
tests.tagline: Essential neuro-vitamin check for memory, tingling, numbness and weakness
tests.description: Measures serum Vitamin B12 critical for nerve myelin sheath maintenance, brain function, and normal red blood cell production.
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting (8-10 hours) recommended.

tests.name: Tropical Fever Profile by PCR
tests.tagline: Molecular multiplex PCR identifying 5 major tropical fever pathogens simultaneously
tests.description: Advanced DNA/RNA molecular amplification providing definitive pathogen identification in acute unexplained fevers.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Collect during acute febrile stage.

tests.name: Dengue NS-1 Antigen Rapid & Platelet Check
tests.tagline: Rapid Day-1 to Day-5 dengue fever confirmation with platelet monitoring
tests.description: Detects the non-structural dengue protein from the very first day of fever, combined with a precise platelet count for hemorrhagic risk.
testsIncluded: Dengue NS-1 Antigen Rapid Chromatographic Assay
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Immediate doorstep sample collection available.

tests.name: Malarial Antigen Detection & Peripheral Smear (MP)
tests.tagline: Dual antigen rapid test and gold standard Giemsa microscopy
tests.description: Detects both P. falciparum and P. vivax antigens with thick and thin peripheral smear examination for parasite identification.
testsIncluded: Peripheral Blood Smear (PBS) for Malarial Parasite
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Best collected during peak fever chills.

tests.name: Typhoid Fever Profile (Typhi Dot & Widal Test)
tests.tagline: Early IgM/IgG antibodies and agglutination titer for enteric typhoid fever
tests.description: Evaluates acute Salmonella typhi infection using rapid Typhi Dot antibodies confirmed with quantitative tube Widal agglutination.
testsIncluded: Widal Slide & Tube Test (TO, TH, AH, BH Titer)
tests.preparation: No fasting required.

tests.name: Senior Citizen Vitality & Bone Density Panel
tests.tagline: Laboratory assessment for older adults
tests.description: A listed laboratory panel for clinician-directed assessment in older adults. It does not measure bone density or guarantee detection of joint or memory conditions.
testsIncluded: PSA for Men / CA-125 for Women
tests.preparation: 10-12 hours fasting. Continue regular BP medications with sips of water.

tests.name: Rheumatoid Factor (RF) & Anti-CCP Joint Profile
tests.tagline: Differentiate rheumatoid arthritis from osteoarthritis and chronic joint pain
tests.description: Evaluates high-specificity Anti-CCP autoantibodies and Rheumatoid Factor for early diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory arthritis.
tests.preparation: Fasting preferred but not mandatory.

tests.name: Anti Nuclear Antibodies (ANA Screening by IFA)
tests.tagline: Gold standard immunofluorescence assay for lupus and autoimmune diseases
tests.description: Standard initial diagnostic screen for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), Sjogren's, scleroderma, and systemic autoimmune disorders.
testsIncluded: Antibody Titer & Nuclear Pattern Analysis (Homogeneous, Speckled, Nucleolar)
tests.preparation: No fasting required.
